items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is small, follows the surrounding style, and has a comment explaining why `<= 1` is used: "no active tables (e.g. Model.objects.all())".

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Patches the symptom in two places instead of calling the existing `query.get_initial_alias()` helper. The `query.base_table or query.get_meta().db_table` fallback duplicates base-table resolution logic inside `_as_sql`.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No exception handling is involved. The `None` base_table case is handled explicitly with a fallback to the model's `db_table`, and no errors are swallowed. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Joined deletes still count more than one alias and keep the subquery, and the MySQL override works. But `<= 1` plus the `base_table or ...db_table` fallback is a special case for the empty `alias_map`, not registering the base alias as the root-cause fix would.
